lines.text: Count in blocks! One to ninety-nine uses one hundred eighty-nine digits.
lines.caption: Count in blocks! 1 to 99 uses 189 digits.

lines.text: That leaves one thousand eight hundred thirty-seven digits.

lines.text: Three digits each: six hundred twelve numbers, remainder one.

lines.text: Starting at one hundred, they run up to seven hundred eleven.

lines.text: The remainder one is the first digit of seven hundred twelve. A seven!
lines.caption: The remainder 1 is the first digit of 712. A 7!

lines.text: Six was the trap. The numbers start at one hundred.
